Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

CARGO POD EMPLACEMENT POINTS AVAILABILITY SIZE RESTRICTION COST
Light 0 Common Gargantuan or Larger 500 (Base)
Medium 1 Common Colossal or Larger 1000 (Base)
Heavy 2 Common Colossal (Frigate) or Larger 1500 (Base)

Cargo Pods are additional storage space added to a ship to boost its total carrying capacity. Though they allow independent traders to carry more goods, they also reduce a ship's ability to maneuver quickly, making them unpopular with pirates and military craft. Each Cargo Pod added to a Starship reduces its Dexterity score by 2. You can add multiple Cargo Pods to a Starship, but cannot add a Cargo Pod if it would drop the Starship's Dexterity below 1.

The additional carrying capacity is based on the size of the Starship. A Small Cargo Pod adds (Cost Modifier) x 1 tons of cargo. A Medium Cargo Pod adds (Cost Modifier) x 5 tons of cargo. A Large Cargo Pod adds (Cost Modifier) x 10 tons of cargo.

A Cargo Pod can be made detachable (to act as an Escape Pod) for five times the cost.

Additional Emplacement Points from Cargo Pods

Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Web Enhancements (Jedi Counseling)

Q: Can you gain Emplacement Points by converting the cargo space provided by a Cargo Pod?

A: No. A Starship can only convert its own internal cargo space into Emplacement Points.
